title: ‘Hair is my identity’: Student sells textured-hair products from Village vending machine
summary_en: Zariah Taylor, a senior and Sam Fox School fashion design student, has launched TheHairVault, a vending machine for textured-hair products, in the Village, with support from the Skandalaris Center’s Student Enterprise Program.
